title: Only the document hooks run on the light GraphQL client; drive, node, job and package hooks require a full host
content:
`@powerhousedao/reactor-browser` ships a second, much smaller client — `GraphQLReactorClient`, mounted with `GraphQLReactorProvider url={...}` — that satisfies the document hooks by talking plain GraphQL to a Switchboard. No reactor, no PGlite, no job queue in the bundle. It is how a plain webapp gets `useDocument`, `useDispatch` and `useReactorClient`.

The line between "works" and "finds nothing" is drawn by an interface. `IReactorBrowserClient` — what the hooks depend on, and what both this client and the full reactor client implement — is declared as a `Pick` of the reactor's own `IReactorClient` so the signatures cannot drift. It has exactly six members:

| Member | Note |
| --- | --- |
| `get(identifier, view?, signal?)` | by id or slug; a `view.revision` throws — no point-in-time reads |
| `getOperations(identifier, view?, filter?, …)` | paged, `next()` follows the cursor |
| `create(document, parentIdentifier?, signal?)` | emits `Created` |
| `execute(identifier, branch, actions, signal?)` | fetches, stamps, signs, pushes |
| `deleteDocument(identifier, propagate?, signal?)` | emits `Deleted` |
| `subscribe(search, callback, view?)` | local emissions plus, lazily, the server's |

Everything outside those six — `drives`, `find`, `resolveIdOrSlug`, relationships, jobs, `rename`, `executeBatch`, the document-model module getters — is not on the interface and not implemented, which is why the drive, node and job hooks do not work below this provider.

The package and module hooks fail for a different reason: `useVetraPackages`, `useDocumentModelModules`, `useEditorModules`, `useEditorModuleById` and the rest read `window.ph.vetraPackageManager`, a slot only a host application fills. Passing `documentModels` to the provider publishes a fixed `StaticPackageManager` into that slot, which makes the document-model module hooks work — but it never installs, updates or removes packages and its mutating members throw.

Editors are explicitly not portable here: they read the selected document through Connect's drive/node selection, which a light app deliberately has no equivalent of.

_Source: packages/reactor-browser/src/graphql-client/README.md, confirmed by apps/academy/docs/academy/04-Reference/05-EditorsUI/01-ReactHooks.md (Powerhouse v6.2.2-dev.45)._
description: IReactorBrowserClient is a Pick of IReactorClient with exactly six members. Package and module hooks read window.ph.vetraPackageManager, which only a host application fills.
